env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd internal
! logos test ./...
stderr 'in_test\.lgo:5:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
cd ..

cd xtest
! logos test ./forbid
stderr 'x_test\.lgo:5:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! stdout '^ok'

! logos test ./deny
stderr 'x_test\.lgo:9:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! stdout '^ok'

logos test ./allowed
stdout '^ok'
! stderr 'slop::discarded_error'

cp logos-allow.toml logos.toml
logos test ./deny
stdout '^ok'
! stderr 'slop::discarded_error'
cd ..

-- internal/go.mod --
module example.com/internal

go 1.27

-- internal/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- internal/in_test.lgo --
package foo

import "testing"

func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	if Name() != "foo" {
		t.Fatal("bad name")
	}
}

-- xtest/go.mod --
module example.com/xtest

go 1.27

-- xtest/logos-allow.toml --
[lints]
slop = "allow"

-- xtest/forbid/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- xtest/forbid/x_test.lgo --
package foo_test

import "testing"

func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("ran")
}

-- xtest/deny/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- xtest/deny/x_test.lgo --
package foo_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- xtest/allowed/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- xtest/allowed/x_test.lgo --
package foo_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}
